sources.locator: Title search: 密码算法与密钥长度过渡

statement.zh: **标准**：密码算法与密钥长度过渡（Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths）。这份文件的度量单位是`安全强度`：「In SP 800-57, the security strength provided by an algorithm with a particular key length … is measured in bits and is a measure of the difficulty of subverting the cryptographic protection that is provided by the algorithm and key.」并且强调「Note that the length of the cryptographic keys is an integral part of these determinations.」——算法与密钥长度必须一起判定。
statement.en: **Standard**: Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths (密码算法与密钥长度过渡).The unit of this publication is security strength: "In SP 800-57, the security strength provided by an algorithm with a particular key length … is measured in bits and is a measure of the difficulty of subverting the cryptographic protection that is provided by the algorithm and key." It stresses that "Note that the length of the cryptographic keys is an integral part of these determinations." — algorithm and key length are judged together.

statement.zh: 过渡之所以要成文，是因为算法会随算力失效：文件为联邦政府设定当下下限——「For the Federal Government, a security strength of at least 112 bits is required at this time for applying cryptographic protection (e.g., for encrypting or signing data).」，并把未来变数写进定义——「When post-quantum cryptography is introduced in NIST standards, quantum security strength, i.e.the difficulty of subverting the protection using quantum computers, will be defined.」，术语注释把口径本身一并给出：「The term "security strength" refers to the classical security strength - a measure of the difficulty of subverting the cryptographic protection (e.g., discovering the key) using classical computers.」。
statement.en: Transitions need a written schedule because algorithms decay with computing power: the publication sets a floor for the federal government today — "For the Federal Government, a security strength of at least 112 bits is required at this time for applying cryptographic protection (e.g., for encrypting or signing data)." — and flags the future change in its own definitions, "When post-quantum cryptography is introduced in NIST standards, quantum security strength, i.e.the difficulty of subverting the protection using quantum computers, will be defined.

statement.zh: 落地面是逐个算法清点：§2 从分组密码开始——「Encryption is a cryptographic operation that is used to provide confidentiality for sensitive information, and decryption is the inverse operation.」并列出联邦用过的算法族，如「The Triple Data Encryption Algorithm (TDEA) (often referred to as Triple DES) is specified in SP 800-67, and has two variations, known as two-key TDEA and three-key TDEA.」。
statement.en: The work is an algorithm-by-algorithm inventory: §2 opens with block ciphers — "Encryption is a cryptographic operation that is used to provide confidentiality for sensitive information, and decryption is the inverse operation." — and lists the families used federally, for instance "The Triple Data Encryption Algorithm (TDEA) (often referred to as Triple DES) is specified in SP 800-67, and has two variations, known as two-key TDEA and three-key TDEA."。.

statement.zh: 限度一是身份：它是建议性指南而非 FIPS，权威声明写「such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems」，并加一句「Nothing in this publication should be taken to contradict the standards and guidelines made mandatory and binding on federal agencies by the Secretary of Commerce under statutory authority.」，权威声明还说它是「may be used by nongovernmental organizations on a voluntary basis and is not subject to copyright in the United States」的公开指南。
statement.en: The first limit is its standing: it is a recommendation, not a FIPS — the authority block says "such standards and guidelines shall not apply to national security systems without the express approval of appropriate federal officials exercising policy authority over such systems" and adds "Nothing in this publication should be taken to contradict the standards and guidelines made mandatory and binding on federal agencies by the Secretary of Commerce under statutory authority.", and the same block describes the publication as one that "may be used by nongovernmental organizations on a voluntary basis and is not subject to copyright in the United States".

statement.zh: 版本史可从自身与引用中读出：这是 Revision 2，标题行写「NIST Special Publication 800-131A Revision 2 Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths」；脚注 13 还把椭圆曲线批准口径挂到别处——「Until SP 800-186 is published, approved elliptic curves are specified in FIPS 186-4.」，把 TDEA 的弃用计划链接到 2017 年的 NIST 公告。该曲线指针只是 2019 年时的临时安排：本语料库内的 SP 800-186 标题日期为 2023 年 2 月，FIPS 186-5 亦于 2023 年 2 月 3 日取代 186-4，因此「approved elliptic curves are specified in FIPS 186-4」在今天已不成立。
statement.en: Its history is legible from itself and its citations: this is Revision 2, titled "NIST Special Publication 800-131A Revision 2 Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths"; footnote 13 outsources curve approval — "Until SP 800-186 is published, approved elliptic curves are specified in FIPS 186-4." — and ties TDEA deprecation to a 2017 NIST announcement; that curve pointer was a 2019 placeholder only — SP 800-186 in this corpus is dated February 2023 and FIPS 186-5 superseded 186-4 on 3 February 2023, so the sentence no longer holds today.
